verdict.rationale: Catalog and inventory management is a fair question for an in-person POS payments product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence covers only payments, reader fleet management, offline payment storage, tipping, receipts and refunds. Nothing documents an item catalog, inventory counts, or syncing them across registers and channels.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can manage an item catalog with inventory counts that stay in sync across registers and channels
